downloadIntro.zh: Windows 版已更新至 v1.59.60，Mac 版当前为 v1.59.30。请选择与你的电脑匹配的安装包。
downloadIntro.en: Windows is now v1.59.60; the current Mac release is v1.59.30. Choose the installer that matches your computer.

summary.zh: 适用于常见的 Intel 与 AMD 电脑，提供标准安装程序。
summary.en: For common Intel and AMD PCs, delivered as a standard installer.

summary.zh: 适用于 Apple 芯片 Mac，以 DMG 磁盘映像安装。
summary.en: For Apple silicon Macs, delivered as a DMG disk image.

highlights.zh: 画线快捷键按 TradingView 的方式工作：鼠标在 K 线区时，Alt+H / Alt+J / Alt+V / Alt+C 直接在鼠标处画出水平线、水平射线、垂直线、十字线（带磁吸），鼠标在别处时仍只是选中工具；Ctrl+X 剪切画线，Esc 取消选中，画矩形时按住 Shift 画正方形。画线工具的提示和下拉菜单每行右侧标出对应按键。
highlights.en: Drawing shortcuts work as in TradingView: with the mouse over the candles, Alt+H / Alt+J / Alt+V / Alt+C draw a horizontal line, horizontal ray, vertical line or cross line right there (with the magnet); elsewhere they still just pick the tool. Ctrl+X cuts a drawing, Esc clears the selection, and Shift while drawing a rectangle makes a square. Drawing tool tooltips and menu rows show each tool's key.

highlights.zh: X 键显示或隐藏历史交易连线，和显示菜单、设置里的「历史交易连线」是同一个开关，重启后保留。
highlights.en: X shows or hides the trade history lines. It is the same switch as Trade history lines in the display menu and in Settings, and it is kept across restarts.

highlights.zh: 画线模板菜单里可以删除已保存的模板：鼠标移到模板上会出现删除按钮。
highlights.en: Saved drawing templates can be deleted from the template menu: hover a template to show its delete button.

highlights.zh: 快捷键在 Windows 上写成 Ctrl / Alt / Shift，以前设置里的快捷键列表在 Windows 上也显示 Mac 符号；图表右键「粘贴绘图」标出按键，策略条件编辑器在 Windows 上提示按 Ctrl+Enter 保存。
highlights.en: Shortcuts read Ctrl / Alt / Shift on Windows; the shortcut list in Settings used to show Mac symbols there. The chart's Paste drawing item shows its key, and the strategy condition editor tells Windows users to press Ctrl+Enter to save.

highlights.zh: 编辑一条画线时，其他画线也会被改动，锁定的也不例外：落在周末、缺数据的日子或窗口外的端点，会被挪到前一根 K 线上。
highlights.en: Editing one drawing changed the others, locked ones included: points on a weekend, a missing day or outside the loaded window moved to the bar before.

highlights.zh: 只在当前周期显示的画线，切换周期后有时还留在图上，位置也不对；开着画线同步拖动画线时，不该显示它的窗格里也会出现预览；Tick 图表不理会画线的显示周期设置。
highlights.en: A drawing shown on the current timeframe only sometimes stayed on the chart, in the wrong place, after a timeframe switch; dragging a synced drawing previewed it in panes that should not show it; tick charts ignored the drawing's timeframe choice.

highlights.zh: 系统切换浅色或深色后，自己改过的图表颜色（比如止损线的颜色）每次启动都会被重置；有几档回放速度（比如 M1 上的 ×10、×50）重启后会变回 ×60。
highlights.en: After a system light/dark switch, chart colours you had changed (such as the stop-loss line) were reset at every start; some replay speeds (such as ×10 and ×50 on M1) went back to ×60 after a restart.

highlights.zh: 登录：杀毒或备份软件占着登录文件时，刷新后的登录状态会丢；登录文件一时读不出来时，软件会退出账号、换一个新设备号，多占一个设备名额。现在会等文件释放，读不出来时保持原样。
highlights.en: Sign-in: while antivirus or backup software held the sign-in file, the refreshed sign-in was lost; when the file could not be read for a moment, the app signed out and took a new device id, using up a second device seat. It now waits for the file and leaves it as it is when it cannot be read.

highlights.zh: MT5 的允许地址：设置、实盘检查清单和 EA 提示统一写 127.0.0.1。以前设置里写的 http://127.0.0.1:7311 只能让同步连上，实盘连接会失败。
highlights.en: MT5 allowed address: Settings, the live checklist and the EA messages all ask for 127.0.0.1. The http://127.0.0.1:7311 that Settings used to show let only the sync through, and the live connection failed.
